title: When healthier eating emits more: Socioeconomic divergence in US diet sustainability
abstract: Efforts to improve the sustainability of diets require a joint understanding of how nutritional quality and environmental impact vary across social and economic groups, and how they respond to policy levers, going beyond the now-standard “eat less meat” recommendation, too often repeated without asking who is actually able to change and how. Using nationally representative dietary data from the United States, we introduce a Data Envelopment Analysis framework that jointly scores how close each observed diet is to the best nutrition–emissions combinations already achievable in the population; we then combine this with regression and generalized additive models to identify how income, price, and education shape this nutrition–environment trade-off. We find that improvements in diet quality do not uniformly reduce environmental impact: among middle-income groups, income increase is associated with healthier diets but substantially higher emissions, whereas among high-income groups, further income gains reinforce both better nutritional profiles and lower emissions. Education exhibits a strongly nonlinear effect, with substantial gains in diet quality and large reductions in emissions emerging only at the highest educational levels. These findings show that sustainable diet policy cannot rely on a single dietary prescription. Targeted, equity-oriented food policies are needed to advance nutrition and climate goals jointly while accounting for differences in socioeconomic constraints, dietary baselines, and capacity to adopt low-emission, high-quality diets.
abstract_zh: 要改善饮食的可持续性，需要共同理解营养质量与环境影响如何在不同社会和经济群体之间存在差异，以及它们如何对政策杠杆作出反应，而不能仅停留于如今流行的“少吃肉”建议——这一建议常被重复提出，却很少追问究竟谁有能力作出改变，以及如何改变。利用美国具有全国代表性的膳食数据，我们提出了一个数据包络分析框架，用以联合评估每一种观察到的饮食与人口中已可实现的最佳营养—排放组合之间的接近程度；随后，我们将其与回归分析和广义可加模型相结合，以识别收入、价格和教育如何塑造这种营养—环境权衡。我们发现，饮食质量的改善并不会一致地降低环境影响：在中等收入群体中，收入增长与更健康的饮食相关，但排放量显著上升；而在高收入群体中，进一步的收入增长既强化了更好的营养结构，也降低了排放。教育呈现强烈的非线性效应：只有在最高教育水平上，饮食质量才会出现显著提升，排放也才大幅下降。这些发现表明，可持续饮食政策不能依赖单一的膳食规范。需要有针对性、注重公平的食品政策，在考虑社会经济约束、膳食基线以及采用低排放、高质量饮食能力差异的同时，共同推进营养与气候目标。

title: Assessing virtual water trade and inequalities in household water footprints across California's counties
abstract: • Inter-county trade only mitigates water shortages in California's South Coast. • The Central Valley export significant virtual water via water-intensive crops. • Higher income groups have a larger per capita water footprint than lower ones. • Policies needed to combine geographic and socioeconomic factors in water saving. A bstract The concept of virtual water trade suggests water flows from water-rich to water-scarce regions, but local disparities are often overlooked. This study uses a multi-regional input-output (MRIO) model to assess virtual water transfers among California's 58 counties and the rest of the conterminous U.S. in 2017. Results show the Central Valley exported large volumes of virtual water via water-intensive crops (e.g., fruits and vegetables) but imported water embodied in industrial, mining, and thermoelectric processes. These imports eased water stress in the Central and South Coast but left Central Valley scarcity unresolved. Linking household consumption with MRIO reveals the highest-income group (US$200k+) had per capita water footprints 1.8 times larger than the lowest-income group (below US$15k). Although household size and consumption patterns mitigated this gap, Central Valley's high water intensity fueled excessive footprints. The study underscores the need for targeted, equitable water management policies, promoting more effective water conservation strategies.
abstract_zh: • 跨县贸易只能缓解加州南海岸的水资源短缺。• 中央谷地通过水密集型作物大量输出虚拟水。• 高收入群体的人均水足迹高于低收入群体。• 需要将地理因素与社会经济因素相结合，制定节水政策。摘要：虚拟水贸易的概念表明，水从水资源丰富的地区流向水资源稀缺的地区，但地方差异常常被忽视。本研究使用多区域投入产出（MRIO）模型，评估了2017年加州58个县与美国其余本土地区之间的虚拟水转移。结果显示，中央谷地通过水密集型作物（如水果和蔬菜）大量输出虚拟水，同时输入了隐含于工业、采矿和火电过程中的水。这些输入缓解了中部和南海岸的水资源压力，但中央谷地的水资源稀缺问题仍未得到解决。将家庭消费与MRIO相结合的分析显示，最高收入组（20万美元以上）的人均水足迹是最低收入组（低于1.5万美元）的1.8倍。尽管家庭规模和消费模式缩小了这一差距，但中央谷地较高的用水强度推高了过高的水足迹。本研究强调，需要有针对性、公平的水资源管理政策，并推动更有效的节水策略。

title: Does interstate trade of agricultural products in the US alleviate land and water stress?
Health–environment efficiency of diets shows nonlinear trends over 1990–2011
abstract: Understanding the impacts of diets on health and the environment, as well as their association with socio-economic development, is key to operationalize and monitor food systems shifts. Here we propose a health–environment efficiency indicator defined as a ratio of health benefits and four key food-related environmental impacts (greenhouse gas emissions, scarcity-weighted water withdrawal, acidifying and eutrophying emissions) to assess how diets have performed in supporting healthy lives in relation to environmental pollution and resource consumption across 195 countries from 1990 to 2011. We find that the health–environment efficiency of each environmental input follows a nonlinear path along the Socio-Demographic Index gradient representing different development levels. Health–environment efficiency first increases thanks to the elimination of child and maternal malnutrition through greater food supply, then decreases driven by additional environmental impacts from a shift to animal products, and finally shows a slow growth in some developed countries again as they shift towards healthier diets.
abstract_zh: 理解饮食对健康和环境的影响，及其与社会经济发展之间的关联，对于落实和监测粮食系统的转型至关重要。本文提出了一个健康—环境效率指标，定义为健康收益与四类主要食物相关环境影响（温室气体排放、稀缺性加权的水资源取用量，以及酸化和富营养化排放）之比，用以评估1990年至2011年间195个国家的饮食在支持健康生活方面，相对于环境污染和资源消耗的表现。我们发现，每一种环境投入的健康—环境效率，沿着代表不同发展水平的社会人口指数（Socio-Demographic Index）梯度呈现非线性路径。健康—环境效率先因通过增加食物供应消除儿童和孕产妇营养不良而提高，随后因转向动物性产品所带来的额外环境影响而下降，最后在一些发达国家随着其转向更健康的饮食而再次缓慢增长。

title: Analyzing the spatial determinants of dockless e-scooter & e-bike trips across four US cities
Tracing toxic chemical releases embodied in US interstate trade and their unequal distribution
abstract: Toxic chemicals have severe impacts on ecosystem, climate change and human health, and the current toxic releases are inequitably distributed across regions. Investigating the toxic release embodied in final demand by states and income groups can reveal the responsibility transfer of different entities. In this paper, we extended the U.S. multi-regional input-output (MRIO) model with toxic chemical release data in 2017 to conduct the production- and consumption-based accounting of toxic release by each state, and the inter-regional transfer of embodied toxic release between states. In addition, this paper analyzed how the toxic releases and inter-state transfer of embodied toxic release have been driven by income groups across states. The results showed that the toxic release from production was highly concentrated on the central states and the Great Lakes Region, while the consumption-based accounting of toxic release was more equally distributed across regions in the US. The non-metallic and metallic products manufacturing sectors were the most important sectors for most states from both production and consumption-based perspectives and were also the most essential sectors for interregional flows of embodied toxic release from Great Lake Region to Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Northeast. Our results also showed that the largest portion (41.88%) of embodied toxic releases were triggered by households' final demand, and that the consumption of the richest 35% of households contributed to more than 50% of the total toxic chemical releases triggered by total final demand of all households.
abstract_zh: 有毒化学物质对生态系统、气候变化和人类健康造成严重影响，而当前的有毒物质排放在各地区之间分布不均。考察各州及各收入群体最终需求中所隐含的有毒物质排放，可以揭示不同主体的责任转移。本文将美国多区域投入产出（MRIO）模型扩展至2017年有毒化学品排放数据，以对各州进行基于生产和基于消费的有毒物质排放核算，并核算各州之间隐含有毒物质排放的区域间转移。此外，本文分析了各州收入群体如何驱动有毒物质排放及其州际转移。结果显示，基于生产的有毒物质排放高度集中于中部各州和五大湖地区，而基于消费的有毒物质排放核算在美国各地区之间分布得更为均衡。非金属和金属制品制造业，无论从生产还是消费视角看，都是大多数州最重要的部门，也是五大湖地区向东南部、中大西洋和东北部地区的隐含有毒排放区域间流动中最关键的部门。结果还显示，隐含有毒排放中最大的部分（41.88%）由家庭最终需求引发，而最富有的35%家庭的消费，贡献了全部家庭最终需求所引发的有毒化学品排放总量的50%以上。

title: Can US multi-state climate mitigation agreements work? A perspective from embedded emission flows
Carbon footprint of American lifestyles: a geodemographic segmentation approach
abstract: In order to deliver substantial reductions of U.S. residential emissions, cost-effective responses to climate change will need to recognize changes in consumer behavior and lifestyles as important mechanisms to mitigate carbon dioxide emissions. Marketing experts have long recognized the usefulness of developing composite variables to target specific consumer lifestyles and have subsequently developed market segmentation approaches to express relationships between geodemographics and consumer behavior. This paper represents the first use of detailed segmentation data to look at US footprint at high spatial resolution. We employ market segmentation data to delineate lifestyles for approximately 70 000 census tracts in the US and develop a spatial framework to better conceptualize lifestyles as location specific typologies of emission drivers. We find that lifestyles are not only very useful in explaining variations in emissions but in fact are as important as income, typically recognized as the major determinant of consumption emissions. Results from our analysis link the differences between suburban and urban footprints directly to lifestyle patterns and illustrate the geographic distribution of emissions resulting from households’ consumption. We find that statistical clustering and consumer classification methods provide a unique perspective for understanding how various CO2 drivers interact and impact household emissions. Our proposed framework suggests that carbon mitigation strategies should move beyond a ‘one-size-fits-all’ approach centered on income and account for community specific lifestyle impacts related to consumer preferences and demographic characteristics at fine spatial scale.
abstract_zh: 为实现美国居民排放的大幅削减，应对气候变化的成本有效型措施需要认识到，消费者行为和生活方式的改变是减缓二氧化碳排放的重要机制。营销专家早已认识到，开发复合变量以锁定特定消费者生活方式十分有用，并随后发展出市场细分方法，以揭示地理人口特征与消费者行为之间的关系。本文首次运用详细的细分数据，以高空间分辨率考察美国的碳足迹。我们利用市场细分数据，为美国约7万个人口普查区划定生活方式类型，并建立空间框架，将生活方式更好地概念化为具有空间特定性的排放驱动因素类型。我们发现，生活方式不仅能很好地解释排放的差异，而且其重要性实际上与收入相当，而收入通常被认为是消费排放的主要决定因素。分析结果将城郊与城市足迹之间的差异直接与生活方式模式联系起来，并揭示了家庭消费所致排放的地理分布。我们发现，统计聚类与消费者分类方法为理解各类二氧化碳驱动因素如何相互作用并影响家庭排放提供了独特视角。我们提出的框架表明，碳减排策略应超越以收入为中心的“一刀切”方式，并在精细的空间尺度上，考虑与消费者偏好和人口特征相关的社区特定生活方式影响。

title: Environmental implications of economic transformation in China's Pearl River Delta region: Dynamics at four nested geographical scales over 1987–2017
Rising agricultural water scarcity in China is driven by expansion of irrigated cropland in water scarce regions
abstract: Increasing agricultural water scarcity is threatening food security and ecosystem sustainability in China. Previous studies showed a deceleration in the growth of irrigation water use in China due to reducing water use intensities of irrigation. However, a finer-scale analysis at the prefecture level is urgently needed to account for the impacts of land management policies and the impact of international food trade in water stress mitigation. Here, we address these gaps and demonstrate that the scarce irrigation water use trend reversed to rising after 2011 through shifting to irrigated cropland, even if grain import reduced water stress at the national scale, and we highlight the specificity of relationships between scarce water use and irrigated cropland change at both the river-basin and prefecture scales. These results call for an urgent re-evaluation of the implementation guidelines of China's Land Requisition-Compensation Balance policy on scarce irrigation water use.
abstract_zh: 日益加剧的农业水资源短缺正威胁着中国的粮食安全和生态系统可持续性。已有研究表明，由于灌溉用水强度下降，中国灌溉用水量的增长已有所放缓。然而，迫切需要在地级市层面开展更精细尺度的分析，以考察土地管理政策的影响以及国际粮食贸易在缓解水资源压力方面的作用。在此，我们弥补了这些研究空白，并证明：尽管粮食进口在全国尺度上降低了水资源压力，但稀缺灌溉用水的使用趋势在2011年后通过向灌溉耕地转移而转为上升；同时，我们强调了在流域和地级市两个尺度上，稀缺用水与灌溉耕地变化之间关系的特殊性。这些结果呼吁迫切重新评估中国耕地占补平衡政策在稀缺灌溉用水方面的实施指导原则。

title: Social interaction and geographic diffusion of iron-biofortified beans in Rwanda
Unequal household carbon footprints in the peak-and-decline pattern of US greenhouse gas emissions
A multi-country meta-analysis on the role of behavioural change in reducing energy consumption and CO2 emissions in residential buildings
Drivers of GHG emissions from dietary transition patterns in China: Supply versus demand options
abstract:
Diets have been changing drastically in China in the recent decades and this change has contributed considerably to greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. In determining effective mitigation strategies for future emissions, it is necessary to know how emissions related to diet vary over time in overall magnitude and due to compositional changes driven by socioeconomic dynamics. This study evaluates the change in dietary GHG emissions in China during the 1997–2011 period by linking environmentally extended input–output tables with individual daily food intake data. It further decomposes the contribution to GHG emission changes of various socioeconomic driving factors. The results show that GHG emissions related to national diet have been decreasing from 1,180 Mt CO
2
e to 640 Mt CO
2
e (a 54% decline), largely due to technical innovation that has reduced the emissions per calorie of food (135% of the total reduction). The change in dietary patterns has had mixed effects, with a decline in calorie intake reducing emissions by 21% while increases in animal‐sourced food consumption have raised emissions by 25%. Our findings stress the importance of technical progress in the historical change in dietary GHG emissions and suggest a focus on behavior changes for future research and policymaking, which has the potential to promote dietary changes toward less animal product consumption. Our findings highlight the importance of both technological and demand‐side behavioral options in reducing the impact of diets on GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，中国的饮食结构发生了剧烈变化，这一变化对温室气体（GHG）排放产生了相当大的影响。在确定未来减排的有效策略时，有必要了解与饮食相关的排放在总量上如何随时间变化，以及由社会经济动态驱动的结构变化如何影响排放。本研究通过将环境扩展投入产出表与个体日常食物摄入数据相联系，评估了1997年至2011年间中国饮食相关温室气体排放的变化。研究进一步分解了各类社会经济驱动因素对温室气体排放变化的贡献。结果显示，全国饮食相关的温室气体排放已从11.80亿吨CO2e下降至6.40亿吨CO2e（降幅为54%），这主要归因于技术创新降低了单位热量食物的排放（占总减排量的135%）。饮食模式的变化产生了混合影响：热量摄入的下降使排放减少了21%，而动物源性食物消费的增加则使排放增加了25%。我们的研究结果强调了技术进步在饮食相关温室气体排放历史变化中的重要性，并建议未来的研究与政策制定应关注行为改变，因为行为改变有可能推动饮食结构向减少动物产品消费的方向转变。我们的研究结果突出了技术选择与需求侧行为选项在降低饮食对温室气体排放影响方面的双重重要性。

Shifts towards healthy diets in the US can reduce environmental impacts but would be unaffordable for poorer minorities
Boosting the eco-friendly sharing economy: the effect of gasoline prices on bikeshare ridership in three US metropolises
abstract: Transportation has become the largest CO2 emitter in the United States in recent years with low gasoline prices standing out from many contributors. As demand side changes are called for reducing car use, the fast-growing sharing economy shows great potential to shift travel demand away from single-occupancy vehicles. Although previous inter-disciplinary research on shared mobility has explored its multitudes of benefits, it is yet to be investigated how the uptake of this eco-friendly sharing scheme is affected by gasoline prices. In this study, we examine the impact of gasoline prices on the use of bikeshare programs in three U.S. metropolises: New York City, Boston, and Chicago. Using bikeshare trip data, we estimate the impact of citywide gasoline prices on both bikeshare trip duration and trip frequency in a generalized linear regression setting. The results suggest that gasoline prices significantly affect bikeshare trip frequency and duration, with a noticeable surge in short trips. Doubling gasoline prices could help save an average of 1933 gallons of gasoline per day in the three cities, approximately 0.04% of the U.S. daily per capita gasoline consumption. Our findings indicate that fuel pricing could be an effective policy tool to support technology driven eco-friendly sharing mobility and boost sustainable transportation.
abstract_zh: 近年来，交通已成为美国最大的二氧化碳排放源，其中低汽油价格是诸多促成因素中尤为突出的一项。随着减少汽车使用的需求侧变革被提上议程，快速增长的共享经济显示出将出行需求从单人驾驶车辆转移出来的巨大潜力。尽管以往关于共享出行的跨学科研究已探讨了其诸多益处，但汽油价格如何影响这种生态友好型共享模式的采用，尚未得到研究。在本研究中，我们考察了汽油价格对美国三大都市——纽约市、波士顿和芝加哥——公共自行车项目使用情况的影响。利用公共自行车出行数据，我们在广义线性回归框架下，估计了全市汽油价格对公共自行车出行时长和出行频次的影响。结果表明，汽油价格显著影响公共自行车的出行频次和时长，短途出行明显激增。汽油价格翻倍，可帮助三座城市每天平均节约1933加仑汽油，约占美国人均日汽油消费量的0.04%。我们的研究结果表明，燃油定价可以成为一种有效的政策工具，以支持技术驱动的生态友好型共享出行并促进可持续交通。

title: Impact of fire and harvest on forest ecosystem services in a species-rich area in the southern Appalachians
On the accuracy of official Chinese crop production data: Evidence from biophysical indexes of net primary production
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 117(41), 25434-25444
abstract: With rapid economic growth and urbanization, there has been an increasing debate on food security and crop supplies in China. Grains have become central to China’s agriculture policy of ensuring food security mostly through domestic supply. Accurate production statistics are essential for research, monitoring, and planning. Recent increases in crop production reported by national statistics have come under increasing scrutiny. This paper provides an approach to validate Chinese official grain data, based on integrated socioecological indicators of terrestrial net primary production. This approach, grounded on agriculture’s biophysical spatially explicit constraints, provides a powerful means to check the plausibility of China’s grain production statistics at different administrative levels, generates insights about their discrepancies, and can contribute to improved crop production measurements.
abstract_zh: 随着经济快速增长和城镇化推进，关于中国粮食安全和作物供给的争论日益激烈。粮食已成为中国农业政策的核心，中国的粮食安全政策主要通过国内供给来保障。准确的生产统计数据对于研究、监测和规划至关重要。近来，国家统计部门报告的作物产量增长日益受到审视。本文提出了一种基于陆地净初级生产力综合社会生态指标来验证中国官方粮食数据的方法。该方法立足于农业在生物物理方面的空间明确约束，为检验中国不同行政层级粮食产量统计数据的合理性提供了有力手段，能够揭示其差异的成因，并有助于改进作物产量的测度。

Future urban land expansion and implications for global croplands
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 114(34), 8939-8944
abstract: Urbanization’s contribution to land use change emerges as an important sustainability concern. Here, we demonstrate that projected urban area expansion will take place on some of the world’s most productive croplands, in particular in megaurban regions in Asia and Africa. This dynamic adds pressure to potentially strained future food systems and threatens livelihoods in vulnerable regions.
abstract_zh: 城镇化对土地利用变化的贡献，日益成为一个重要的可持续性问题。本文表明，预计的城市建成区扩张将占用世界上一些生产力最高的耕地，尤其是在亚洲和非洲的超大城市区域。这一动态给未来可能已经紧张的粮食系统增加了压力，并威胁到脆弱地区的生计。

title: Global carbon inequality
abstract: Global climate change and inequality are inescapably linked both in terms of who contributes climate change and who suffers the consequences. This fact is also partly reflected in two United Nations (UN) processes: on the one hand, the Paris Agreement of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change under which countries agreed to hold the increase in the global average temperature to below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels and, on the other hand, the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals aiming to end poverty. These agreements are seen as important foundation to put the world nations on a sustainable pathway. However, how these agreements can be achieved or whether they are even mutually compatible is less clear. We explore the global carbon inequality between and within countries and the carbon implications of poverty alleviation by combining detailed consumer expenditure surveys for different income categories for a wide range of countries with an environmentally extended multi-regional input–output approach to estimate carbon footprints of different household groups, globally, and assess the carbon implications of moving the poorest people out of poverty. Given the current context, increasing income leads to increasing carbon footprints and makes global targets for mitigating greenhouse gases more difficult to achieve given the pace of technological progress and current levels of fossil fuel dependence. We conclude that the huge level of carbon inequality requires a critical discussion of undifferentiated income growth. Current carbon-intensive lifestyles and consumption patterns need to enter the climate discourse to a larger extent.
abstract_zh: 全球气候变化与不平等在两个层面上不可分割地联系在一起：谁造成了气候变化，以及谁承受其后果。这一事实在联合国的两项进程中也得到了部分体现：一方面，《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的《巴黎协定》要求各国将全球平均气温升幅控制在工业化前水平以上2摄氏度以内；另一方面，联合国旨在消除贫困的可持续发展目标（SDGs）。这些协议被视为使各国走上可持续发展道路的重要基础。然而，这些目标如何实现，甚至它们是否能够相互兼容，目前尚不清楚。我们结合覆盖多个国家、按不同收入类别划分的详细消费者支出调查数据，以及环境扩展的多区域投入产出方法，估算了全球不同家庭群体的碳足迹，并评估了使最贫困人口脱贫所带来的碳影响，从而探讨了全球范围内国家之间和国家内部的碳不平等，以及减贫的碳影响。在当前背景下，收入增长会导致碳足迹增加，而考虑到技术进步的速度和当前对化石燃料的依赖程度，这使得实现全球温室气体减排目标更加困难。我们认为，如此巨大的碳不平等要求对无差别的收入增长进行批判性讨论。当前高碳的生活方式和消费模式，需要更大程度地进入气候议题的讨论之中。

title: Global income inequality and carbon footprints
venue: Environmental and Economic Impacts of Decarbonization: Input-Output Studies (book chapter)
abstract: The United Nations have set targets to eradicate extreme poverty by 2030. In parallel, in the Paris Agreement of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change the aim is to keep warming below 2°C. However, both agreements do not prescribe how these goals may be achieved in a compatible manner, nor how the burden or responsibility of achieving them may be shared. Clearly, lifestyles, consumption patterns and associated per capita carbon footprints differ enormously between rich and poor. To explore this issue, we use consumer expenditure surveys linked to a global multi-regional input-output model. Decarbonization efforts, as suggested by the Paris Agreement, can help ameliorate global emission growth from household consumption, but lifestyles and income growth need to be part of the global discourse of mitigating climate change.
abstract_zh: 联合国已设定目标，要在2030年前消除极端贫困。与此同时，《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的《巴黎协定》旨在将全球变暖控制在2摄氏度以内。然而，这两项协议都没有规定如何以相互兼容的方式实现这些目标，也没有规定实现这些目标的负担或责任应如何分担。显然，富人与穷人之间的生活方式、消费模式以及相应的人均碳足迹存在巨大差异。为探讨这一问题，我们将消费者支出调查与全球多区域投入产出模型相结合。正如《巴黎协定》所建议的那样，脱碳努力有助于缓解家庭消费导致的全球排放增长，但生活方式和收入增长也需要纳入全球减缓气候变化的讨论之中。

title: Poverty eradication in a carbon constrained world
abstract: The UN Framework Convention on Climate Change aims to keep warming below 2 °C while recognizing developing countries’ right to eradicate extreme poverty. Poverty eradication is also the first of the Sustainable Development Goals. This paper investigates potential consequences for climate targets of achieving poverty eradication. We find that eradicating extreme poverty, i.e., moving people to an income above $1.9 purchasing power parity (PPP) a day, does not jeopardize the climate target even in the absence of climate policies and with current technologies. On the other hand, bringing everybody to a still modest expenditure level of at least $2.97 PPP would have long-term consequences on achieving emission targets. Compared to the reference mitigation pathway, eradicating extreme poverty increases the effort by 2.8% whereas bringing everybody to at least $2.97 PPP would increase the required mitigation rate by 27%. Given that the top 10% global income earners are responsible for 36% of the current carbon footprint of households; the discourse should address income distribution and the carbon intensity of lifestyles.
abstract_zh: 《联合国气候变化框架公约》旨在将全球变暖控制在2摄氏度以内，同时承认发展中国家消除极端贫困的权利。消除贫困也是可持续发展目标中的第一项。本文考察了实现消除贫困对气候目标可能产生的后果。我们发现，消除极端贫困，即使所有人的收入达到每天1.9美元（购买力平价，PPP）以上，即使在没有气候政策且采用现有技术的情况下，也不会危及气候目标。另一方面，若使所有人的支出水平达到仍然不高的每天至少2.97美元（PPP），则会对实现排放目标产生长期影响。与参考减排路径相比，消除极端贫困会使努力程度提高2.8%，而使所有人达到每天至少2.97美元（PPP）则会使所需的减排速率提高27%。鉴于全球收入最高的10%人口对当前家庭碳足迹的贡献率为36%，相关讨论应当关注收入分配以及生活方式的碳强度。

Global typology of urban energy use and potentials for an urbanization mitigation wedge
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 112(20), 6283-6288
abstract: Many case studies of specific cities have investigated factors that contribute to urban energy use and greenhouse-gas emissions. The analysis in this study is based on data from 274 cities and three global datasets and provides a typology of urban attributes of energy use. The results highlight that appropriate policies addressing urban climate change mitigation differ with type of city. A global urbanization wedge, corresponding in particular to energy-efficient urbanization in Asia, might reduce urban energy use by more than 25%, compared with a business-as-usual scenario.
abstract_zh: 许多针对特定城市的案例研究都考察了影响城市能源利用和温室气体排放的因素。本研究基于274个城市的数据以及三个全球数据集，提出了城市能源利用属性的类型学。结果表明，应对城市气候变化减缓的适当政策因城市类型而异。与照常情景相比，以亚洲节能型城镇化为主要内容的全球城镇化减排楔（urbanization wedge）可能使城市能源利用减少超过25%。

title: Getting serious about categorizing countries
Carbon footprints of cities and other human settlements in the UK
abstract: A growing body of literature discusses the CO 2 emissions of cities. Still, little is known about emission patterns across density gradients from remote rural places to highly urbanized areas, the drivers behind those emission patterns and the global emissions triggered by consumption in human settlements—referred to here as the carbon footprint. In this letter we use a hybrid method for estimating the carbon footprints of cities and other human settlements in the UK explicitly linking global supply chains to local consumption activities and associated lifestyles. This analysis comprises all areas in the UK, whether rural or urban. We compare our consumption-based results with extended territorial CO 2 emission estimates and analyse the driving forces that determine the carbon footprint of human settlements in the UK. Our results show that 90% of the human settlements in the UK are net importers of CO 2 emissions. Consumption-based CO 2 emissions are much more homogeneous than extended territorial emissions. Both the highest and lowest carbon footprints can be found in urban areas, but the carbon footprint is consistently higher relative to extended territorial CO 2 emissions in urban as opposed to rural settlement types. The impact of high or low density living remains limited; instead, carbon footprints can be comparatively high or low across density gradients depending on the location-specific socio-demographic, infrastructural and geographic characteristics of the area under consideration. We show that the carbon footprint of cities and other human settlements in the UK is mainly determined by socio-economic rather than geographic and infrastructural drivers at the spatial aggregation of our analysis. It increases with growing income, education and car ownership as well as decreasing household size. Income is not more important than most other socio-economic determinants of the carbon footprint. Possibly, the relationship between lifestyles and infrastructure only impacts carbon footprints significantly at higher spatial granularity.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献讨论了城市的二氧化碳排放。然而，人们对于从偏远农村地区到高度城市化地区的密度梯度上的排放模式、这些排放模式背后的驱动因素，以及人类聚落消费所引发的全球排放（本文称之为碳足迹）知之甚少。在本信中，我们采用一种混合方法，估算英国城市和其他人类聚落的碳足迹，明确地将全球供应链与本地消费活动及相关生活方式联系起来。本分析涵盖英国所有地区，无论农村还是城市。我们将基于消费的结果与扩展的领土二氧化碳排放估算进行比较，并分析决定英国人类聚落碳足迹的驱动力。结果显示，英国90%的人类聚落是二氧化碳排放的净输入者。基于消费的二氧化碳排放比扩展的领土排放要均匀得多。最高和最低的碳足迹都出现在城市地区，但相对于扩展的领土二氧化碳排放而言，城市类型聚落的碳足迹始终高于农村类型聚落。高密度或低密度居住的影响仍然有限；相反，碳足迹在不同密度梯度上的高低，取决于所考察区域特定的社会人口、基础设施和地理特征。我们发现，在本分析的空间汇总尺度上，英国城市和其他人类聚落的碳足迹主要由社会经济因素而非地理和基础设施因素决定。碳足迹随收入、教育水平和汽车拥有率的提高而增加，并随家庭规模的缩小而增加。收入在决定碳足迹的各项社会经济因素中并不比大多数其他因素更为重要。生活方式与基础设施之间的关系，可能只有在更高的空间精细度上才会对碳足迹产生显著影响。

title: Modeling of financial incentives for investments in energy storage systems that promote the large-scale integration of wind energy

Integrated regulation of nonpoint pollution: Combining managerial controls and economic instruments under multiple environmental targets
abstract: Regulators are often reluctant to rely solely on economic incentives to achieveenvironmental standards. We evaluate a "mixed approach" of economic instruments andmanagement standards when two environmental objectives need to be met simultaneously:minimum river flow rates and reductions in nitrate pollution. We show how the relativeefficiency of such mixed approaches can depend on exogenous factors, in this case weatherconditions. Results indicate that mixed instruments outperform stand-alone economicincentives or managerial controls under wet weather conditions, but not in 'average' years. However, the relative cost-effectiveness of mixed approaches increases considerably at higher levels of environmental standard compliance.
abstract_zh: 监管者往往不愿仅依靠经济激励来实现环境标准。当需要同时实现两个环境目标时，即最低河流流量以及减少硝酸盐污染，我们评估了一种经济工具与管理标准相结合的“混合方法”。我们表明，此类混合方法的相对效率可能取决于外生因素，本文中即天气条件。结果表明，在多雨天气条件下，混合工具的表现优于单独使用的经济激励或管理控制，但在“平均”年份则并非如此。然而，在更高的环境标准达标水平下，混合方法的相对成本效益会显著提高。

title: The impact of social factors and consumer behavior on carbon dioxide emissions in the United Kingdom: A regression based on input-output and geodemographic consumer segmentation data
abstract:
In this article we apply geodemographic consumer segmentation data in an input−output framework to understand the direct and indirect carbon dioxide (CO
2
) emissions associated with consumer behavior of different lifestyles in the United Kingdom. In a subsequent regression analysis, we utilize the lifestyle segments contained in the dataset to control for aspects of behavioral differences related to lifestyles in an analysis of the impact of various socioeconomic variables on CO
2
emissions, such as individual aspirations and people's attitudes toward the environment, as well as the physical context in which people act.
This approach enables us to (1) test for the significance of lifestyles in determining CO
2
emissions, (2) quantify the importance of a variety of individual socioeconomic determinants, and (3) provide a visual representation of “where” the various factors exert the greatest impact, by exploiting the spatial information contained in the lifestyle data.
Our results indicate the importance of consumer behavior and lifestyles in understanding CO
2
emissions in the United Kingdom. Across lifestyle groups, CO
2
emissions can vary by a factor of between 2 and 3. Our regression results provide support for the idea that sociodemographic variables are important in explaining emissions. For instance, controlling for lifestyles and other determinants, we find that emissions are increasing with income and decreasing with education. Using the spatial information, we illustrate how the lifestyle mix of households in the United Kingdom affects the geographic distribution of environmental impacts.
abstract_zh:
在本文中，我们将地理人口消费者细分数据应用于投入产出框架，以理解英国不同生活方式的消费者行为所关联的直接和间接二氧化碳（CO2）排放。在随后的回归分析中，我们利用数据集中包含的生活方式细分，来控制与生活方式相关的行为差异，以分析各种社会经济变量（如个人抱负、人们对环境的态度以及人们行动所处的物理环境）对CO2排放的影响。
这一方法使我们能够（1）检验生活方式在决定CO2排放中的显著性，（2）量化各种个体社会经济决定因素的重要性，以及（3）通过利用生活方式数据中包含的空间信息，直观地呈现各种因素在“何处”产生最大影响。
我们的结果表明，消费者行为和生活方式对理解英国的CO2排放具有重要意义。在不同生活方式群体之间，CO2排放可相差2至3倍。我们的回归结果支持如下观点：社会人口变量对解释排放具有重要作用。例如，在控制生活方式和其他决定因素之后，我们发现排放量随收入增加而上升，随教育水平提高而下降。利用空间信息，我们说明了英国家庭的生活方式构成如何影响环境影响的地理分布。

title: Understanding Changes in the UK's CO2 Emissions: A Global Perspective
Input–output analysis and carbon footprinting: an overview of applications
abstract: This article provides an overview of how generalised multi-regional input–output models can be used for carbon footprint applications. We focus on the relevance and suitability of such evidence to inform decision making. Such an overview is currently missing. Drawing on UK results, we cover carbon footprint applications in seven areas: national emissions inventories and trade, emission drivers, economic sectors, supply chains, organisations, household consumption and lifestyles as well as sub-national emission inventories. The article highlights the multiple uses of generalised multi-regional input–output models for carbon footprinting and concludes by highlighting important avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了如何将广义多区域投入产出模型用于碳足迹核算的应用。我们关注此类证据与支持决策的相关性和适用性。目前尚缺乏此类综述。依托英国的研究结果，我们涵盖了碳足迹核算在七个领域的应用：国家排放清单与贸易、排放驱动因素、经济部门、供应链、组织、家庭消费与生活方式，以及次国家层面的排放清单。本文强调了广义多区域投入产出模型在碳足迹核算中的多种用途，并最后指出了未来研究的重要方向。
